name: BRACE
description: An audio benchmark for evaluating reference-free audio captioning metrics and modality-alignment quality, with an emphasis on robustness under diverse conditions and on assessing audio-language model alignment without relying on human reference captions.
evaluation_method: Correlation with human judgments, robustness testing across conditions, and metric ranking performance for audio caption evaluation metrics such as CLAPScore and related ACEMs.
notes: BRACE is primarily a benchmark for metrics, not a direct generation task. It is intended to stress-test reference-free audio caption quality measures and can also be used to assess LALM alignment.
